fields.Participants: BI Analyst, Category Manager, FP&A, Sustainability Coordinator
fields.Trigger: Monthly reporting cycle — Green Product Sales

workflows.name: Green Product Sales Analytics & Market Intelligence

Automation Opportunity: - Dashboard auto-refreshed from source systems; anomalies auto-flagged; report auto-distributed to stakeholders
Controls: - CTL-465 (ensure controlled execution — Sustainability Compliance & Analytics (PA-78.3).)
- operational: BI Analyst sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Metric-gaming risk**: a metric is gamed (marking complete before actual completion, excluding unfavorable data); mitigated by the source-system ground truth and the cross-metric consistency check

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - ESG/sustainability (links to VS-25 / W114 ESG reporting, W2619 corporate ESG rollup)
- Analytics/BI (links to VS-27 / W113 BI platform, W231 QBR dashboard)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the BI Analyst role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: BI Analyst produces analytics: revenue by green category (energy, water, materials, solar), growth vs. conventional, penetration by store, AOV, segment analysis
Category Manager analyzes trends: Philippine green building growth (15–20% CAGR), competitor offerings, regulatory drivers, consumer awareness
FP&A forecasts: 3-year projection, market share targets, investment required, ROI; presents to CFO and CEO for strategic planning

workflows.name: Environmental Impact Quantification of Green Product Sales

Automation Opportunity: - Certification-expiry auto-tracked with renewal-alerts; ESG-metrics auto-computed from the product/supplier data; compliance-evidence auto-collected from the vendor portal
Controls: - CTL-465 (ensure controlled execution — Sustainability Compliance & Analytics (PA-78.3).)
- operational: Sustainability Coordinator sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Greenwashing risk**: sustainability claims lack evidence (certificates, audit), damaging credibility; mitigated by the evidence requirement and the third-party certification

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - ESG/sustainability (links to VS-25 / W114 ESG reporting, W2619 corporate ESG rollup)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Sustainability Coordinator role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Sustainability Coordinator calculates impact: energy savings (MWh, tons CO2), water savings (liters), trees preserved (FSC wood), VOC reduction, solar capacity installed (kW)
Coordinator validates: uses DOE baselines, water utility data, FSC records, product specs; ensures defensible methodology; documents calculations
Coordinator prepares summary for ESG report: total CO2 avoided, energy/water saved, trees preserved, renewable installed; compares prior year; includes in sustainability report

fields.Participants: Legal Compliance Officer, Sustainability Coordinator, VP Legal
fields.Volume: Philippine Green Building Code, LGU ordinances

Automation Opportunity: - Certification-expiry auto-tracked with renewal-alerts; ESG-metrics auto-computed from the product/supplier data; compliance-evidence auto-collected from the vendor portal
Controls: - CTL-465 (compliance-monitoring — links to VS-22); Operational: Legal Compliance Officer sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Greenwashing risk**: sustainability claims lack evidence (certificates, audit), damaging credibility; mitigated by the evidence requirement and the third-party certification
- **Non-compliance risk**: a regulatory requirement is missed (DTI permit, data privacy, AML), creating a fine or complaint; mitigated by the compliance-checklist and the regulatory-monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Compliance/risk (links to VS-22 / regulatory, VS-86 / AML, VS-91 / privacy)
- ESG/sustainability (links to VS-25 / W114 ESG reporting, W2619 corporate ESG rollup)
Time Estimate: - Volume: Philippine Green Building Code, LGU ordinances
- Absorbed into the Legal Compliance Officer role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Legal Compliance Officer monitors: Green Building Code updates, LGU green building ordinances (Metro Manila requiring BERDE for new buildings), DOE energy labels, DENR EIA requirements
Officer assesses impact: new requirements creating demand (mandatory energy labels, water standards), compliance for own construction, customer advisory opportunities
Sustainability Coordinator incorporates: accelerates green assortment for compliance-driven demand, ensures certifications, trains staff; reports to VP Merchandising

steps.activity: Sustainability Coordinator collects LCA data: raw material sourcing, manufacturing energy, transportation carbon, durability, end-of-life recyclability; stores in sustainability database
Coordinator validates: cross-checks claims, identifies gaps, works with vendors to improve; for key categories engages third-party LCA firm for independent verification
Coordinator uses for product selection: identifies best lifecycle performance, replaces lower-performing, provides LCA to customers; contributes to Scope 3 emissions accounting
